evals.rule_under_test: Upon successful merge, the corresponding features.json entry must transition to status=done
evals.prompt: Feature F002 has status=building and the work is fully merged into main. Complete the finishing workflow.
evals.expected_output: Skill updates F002 status from building to done in features.json. Mirrors the outcome to claude-progress.json. Reports completion to user.

assertions.name: features.json status updated
assertions.check: F002 status field equals 'done' after the skill completes.

evals.rule_under_test: harness:archive must be invoked before reporting completion
evals.prompt: Complete a feature whose work is merged.
evals.expected_output: Skill invokes harness:archive (or its component sub-steps) for doc-sync, architecture scan, structured archive report. Only after archive completes does this skill report 'done' to the user.

assertions.name: archive invoked
assertions.check: Output references harness:archive (or its sub-steps: scan-arch, sync-docs) being run before completion.

assertions.name: completion gated on archive
assertions.check: If archive surfaces inconsistencies, skill does not report completion.

evals.rule_under_test: If the merged work touches deployment surfaces, prompt the user about harness:canary
evals.prompt: Feature touches k8s/deployment.yaml and CI workflow files. Complete the finishing workflow.
evals.expected_output: Skill prompts the user: 'this work touches deployment configs. Run harness:canary for pre-deploy planning?' Does not auto-invoke canary; just surfaces the recommendation.

assertions.name: canary prompt surfaced
assertions.check: Output explicitly asks the user about harness:canary.

assertions.name: canary not auto-invoked
assertions.check: Skill does not invoke canary without user confirmation.
